bronze_male.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Badminton athlete for the Bronze tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: warm tan skin, short straight black hair, dark brown eyes. Visibly junior athlete, approximately 12–14, natural youthful face and proportions, modest practical kit; no adult musculature or jewellery. Collection palette: white and teal academy kit; deep teal/navy with restrained gold accents. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Simple junior white/teal court kit, basic racket and indoor shoes. Equipment: One slender badminton racket and feather shuttlecock. Indoor court shoes. Do not produce a tennis racket or tennis ball. Award: None. Pose: Standing with racket angled safely down, shuttlecock in free hand. Tier silhouette direction: Relaxed introductory three-quarter view; natural asymmetrical weight distribution and curious expression. Establish the junior identity without a stiff catalogue stance. Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.

Sport-specific constraints: Progress through local, national and world-level badminton awards; the final global-excellence honour is an original Workout Tracker design, not a claimed governing-body award.

Reference is rendering finish ONLY, not character or pose or equipment. NEW distinct fictional boy age13, warm tan skin, short STRAIGHT BLACK hair, dark brown eyes. Natural junior proportions, relaxed three-quarter stance feet both on ground, one slender BADMINTON racket angled down and ONE feather shuttlecock free hand. White/teal junior shirt shorts indoor shoes, no ball, no trophy or medal. Full shoes/equipment and clear transparent margins.
